title: VisualSky
description: VisualSky lets you customize your client-side sky, time, and weather without changing the actual server world. Switch between visual day/night and clear/rain/thunder effects locally with keybinds or a config screen.
body:
Requirements:

-Fabric API: https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api

-YetAnotherConfigLib (YACL): https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl

Optional:

-Mod Menu: https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu

## Known Issues

Some versions of Controlify may crash when opening YACL config screens on certain Minecraft versions. If `/visualsky` crashes while Controlify is installed, try updating or disabling Controlify.

## Known Incompatibilities

- BadOptimizations: may break VisualSky’s visual sky/time rendering. Remove or disable BadOptimizations if VisualSky does not render correctly.

# VisualSky

VisualSky is a client-side Fabric mod that lets you customize how the sky, time, and weather look on your own Minecraft client.

It does **not** change the real server time, server weather, or world logic. Everything is visual and local to you.

## Features

- Client-side visual time changer
- Client-side visual weather changer
- Works on vanilla servers
- Toggle between visual day/night modes
- Toggle between clear, rain/snow, and thunder visuals
- Keybind support
- `/visualsky` config command
- Optional Mod Menu integration
- YACL config screen
- Config saving

## Default Keybinds

- `Y` — Cycle visual time mode
- `U` — Cycle visual weather mode

You can change these in Minecraft’s Controls menu.

## Weather Notes

The **Rain/Snow** mode forces precipitation visually.

Minecraft decides whether precipitation appears as rain or snow based on the biome. In snowy/cold biomes it appears as snow, and in normal or warm biomes it appears as rain.

## Client-side Only

VisualSky is fully client-side.

This means:

- It does not change server time
- It does not change server weather
- It does not affect mobs, sleeping, redstone, or daylight sensors
- Other players will not see your selected visual sky/weather
- It works on vanilla servers

## Config

You can open the config screen with:

```text
/visualsky
